subject: Animation
title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Absurdity as Art
description: A quick, practical guide to SpongeBob SquarePants: Absurdity as Art.

hook.text: SpongeBob SquarePants debuted in 1999 and became the most commercially successful Nickelodeon show ever.

buildup.text: Creator Stephen Hillenburg was a marine biologist who brought genuine ocean knowledge to his absurd cartoon.

discovery.text: The show's humor worked on two levels — silly enough for kids, absurd enough for college students and adults.

twist.text: Hillenburg intended the show to end after the 2004 movie. Nickelodeon continued it against his wishes.

climax.text: SpongeBob generated over $13 billion in merchandise and became a global meme template for a generation.

punchline.text: A marine biologist's cartoon sponge became a global empire.

quiz.question: What was SpongeBob creator Stephen Hillenburg's background?
options: He was a marine biologist who brought real ocean knowledge to the show's absurd world
